Appetizers • Jinbeh Lewisville

Hand-Diced Ahi Tuna with Avocado, Sesame, and Citrus Ponzu

Fresh sushi-grade ahi tuna, hand-diced into small cubes and gently tossed with sesame oil, ponzu, and scallions. Served over a bed of ripe avocado with crispy wonton chips for scooping. This is our most refined appetizer. clean, bright flavors that showcase the quality of the fish front and center.

In Japanese, "tataki" means "to hit" or "to pound." The fish is tenderized by pounding it thin, then barely seared on the outside so it stays beautifully rare inside. A very traditional Japanese preparation served with our house-made ponzu sauce.

While tartare originated in French cuisine, the Japanese interpretation emphasizes subtlety: less acid, more umami, and a focus on the pure flavor of the fish.

The tartare is presented over diced avocado, topped with scallions and sesame seeds. Scoop it onto crispy wonton chips for cool, silky tuna, creamy avocado, and satisfying crunch in one bite.

Raw ahi tuna delivers 25g protein with only 120 calories per 4oz serving. The avocado adds healthy fats and potassium. Sesame oil provides vitamin E.

Clean, citrusy, and lightly sesame with ocean-fresh tuna

Tender, silky diced tuna with crispy wonton crunch

Sushi-grade ahi tuna is hand-diced into uniform cubes and delicately tossed with sesame oil, ponzu, scallions, and a touch of soy sauce. Presented over diced avocado with house-made crispy wonton chips.

💡 Pro Tip: Scoop the tartare onto the wonton chips with a bit of avocado on each bite. the creamy, crunchy, fresh combination is incredible.

A refined cocktail for a refined appetizer

Start elegant with tartare, finish grand with surf n' turf

Two different raw fish preparations for the adventurous diner

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

Tuna tartare is hand-diced raw tuna mixed with seasonings. completely uncooked and focused on the pure, clean flavor of the fish. Seared tuna has a pepper-sesame crust and is briefly seared, giving it a thin cooked exterior with a raw center. Both showcase our sushi-grade ahi tuna beautifully.

Cocktails • Jinbeh Lewisville

Our Signature Tropical Cocktail. Fruity, Fun, and Refreshing

Jinbeh's signature house cocktail. a tropical punch that blends fruity sweetness with just the right amount of kick. Made with a mix of spirits, tropical juices, and a splash of citrus, it's colorful, refreshing, and goes down dangerously easy. The drink that puts you in vacation mode from the first sip.

All cocktails at Jinbeh are crafted at a bar featuring a stunning collection of hand-painted tequila bottles. Each bottle is individually painted by artisans from a Mexican village. It took about a year to collect enough empty bottles to line the shelf.

The Jinbeh Punch reflects the restaurant's identity: warm, tropical, and celebratory. It embodies the "celebration since 1988" ethos that defines the Jinbeh brand.

The punch arrives in a specialty glass with tropical garnishes. Vibrant in color and inviting in aroma, the first sip hits with bright fruit sweetness, followed by a smooth spirit finish.

The Jinbeh Punch contains approximately 200 calories per glass. The tropical fruit juices contribute vitamin C and natural sugars.

Tropical, fruity, and refreshing with a citrus finish

Smooth and refreshing, served cold over ice

A proprietary blend of spirits and tropical fruit juices are mixed, shaken with ice, and served in a specialty glass with tropical garnishes. The recipe is a Jinbeh original.

💡 Pro Tip: Start your dinner with a Jinbeh Punch to get into the tropical Japanese mood right away.

Tropical punch with sweet grilled shrimp is summer in a glass

Fruity cocktail with crispy fried tempura. a fun pairing

Matching the tropical vibe with another crowd-pleasing favorite

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

The Jinbeh Punch is our signature house cocktail featuring a proprietary blend of spirits and tropical juices. The exact recipe is a house secret, but expect a refreshing, fruity drink with balanced sweetness and a smooth finish.

It's well-balanced. the tropical flavors make it very easy-drinking, but it does contain a full portion of spirits. It's perfect as a single drink to enjoy with dinner, or as a fun cocktail to sip while waiting for your food.

Cocktails • Jinbeh Lewisville

Elegant, Sweet, and Floral. Our Most Refined Cocktail

Our most elegant cocktail. Premium vodka meets the exotic sweetness of lychee fruit in a beautifully balanced martini that's floral, refreshing, and impossibly smooth. Served in a chilled martini glass with a lychee fruit garnish, it's the perfect accompaniment to sushi and sashimi. or a sophisticated start to any meal.

The Lychee Martini is the most-ordered cocktail among date-night guests at Jinbeh. The exotic sweetness of lychee pairs beautifully with sushi and sashimi. Our bartenders shake it extra cold.

Lychee is a tropical fruit native to southern China, cultivated for over 2,000 years. Its floral, grape-like sweetness translates perfectly into a martini format.

The martini arrives in a chilled glass with a whole lychee fruit resting at the bottom. The cocktail glows with a subtle pearlescent sheen. The first sip is floral and sweet, followed by clean vodka crispness.

A Lychee Martini contains approximately 180 calories. Lychee fruit is rich in vitamin C and provides natural sweetness without heavy syrups.

Sweet, floral lychee with clean vodka crispness

Silky smooth, chilled, and clean on the palate

Premium vodka is shaken with lychee liqueur and lychee juice over ice until perfectly chilled. Strained into a chilled martini glass and garnished with a whole lychee fruit.

💡 Pro Tip: Order it alongside sashimi. the clean, floral lychee and the pristine raw fish elevate each other beautifully.

A refined cocktail with the most refined sashimi

Elegant cocktail meets elegant appetizer

A luxurious drink for a luxurious dinner

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

Lychee is a tropical fruit with a flavor often described as a cross between grape and rose, with a floral sweetness that's completely unique. In our martini, it creates a fragrant, exotic cocktail experience that's refreshing and sophisticated.

It's sweet but balanced. the vodka provides crispness and the ice-cold temperature keeps it refreshing. It's sweeter than a classic martini but not cloying. If you enjoy fruity cocktails, you'll love it.

Also available at our Frisco location

- Sake Bomb
Cocktails • Jinbeh Lewisville

Drop It, Chug It. The Signature Japanese Party Drink

The most celebratory drink in Japanese dining. A warm sake is balanced on chopsticks across a cold beer, then the table drums, the chopsticks collapse, and the sake drops into the beer. You chug it together. It's not just a drink. it's a communal ritual, a celebration starter, and the single most fun thing you can order at a hibachi restaurant.

Sake tradition at Jinbeh goes back decades. Our premium unfiltered sake bottle must be shaken before pouring — the white cloud inside is rice sediment from the authentic unfiltered process.

The Sake Bomb originated in American Japanese restaurants as a communal drinking ritual. Warm sake and cold Japanese beer combine for a smooth, easy-drinking experience.

Your server sets chopsticks across the beer glass and balances the sake cup on top. The table counts "ichi, ni, san, SAKE!" and pounds the table. The sake drops in, you grab the glass, and you drink.

A Sake Bomb contains approximately 250 calories (sake plus beer). The warm sake helps the beer go down smoothly.

Warm sake smoothly blending into crisp, cold Japanese beer

Refreshing and effervescent with sake warmth

A small cup of warm sake is balanced on two chopsticks laid across the top of a pint of cold Japanese beer (typically Sapporo or Kirin). When ready, pound the table. the sake drops in, you pick up the glass, and drink.

💡 Pro Tip: Round up the whole table for Sake Bombs. the synchronized "ichi, ni, san, SAKE!" drumming is the best way to kick off a celebration.

The most celebratory drink with the most celebratory steak

Classic Japanese bar food with a classic Japanese drink ritual

Dramatic drink ritual followed by a dramatic sushi roll

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

A Sake Bomb is a fun drinking ritual: a cup of warm sake is balanced on chopsticks over a beer. When you're ready, everyone pounds the table, the sake drops into the beer, and you drink the combination. It's a communal celebration that's become a tradition at hibachi restaurants.

Absolutely. that's the best way! Sake Bombs are designed as a group activity. Everyone gets their own setup, drums the table in unison, and drinks together. It's perfect for birthdays, celebrations, and group dinners.

Also available at our Frisco location

- Sake Flight
Cocktails • Jinbeh Lewisville

Sample Three Premium Sakes. Find Your Favorite

The best way to explore the world of sake. Our Sake Flight presents three carefully selected sake varieties side by side, letting you compare and discover your personal favorite. From light and crisp junmai to rich and aromatic daiginjo, each sake offers a distinct personality that pairs differently with each dish on our menu.

The truth about sake quality: premium sake always performs better cold. The rice is polished repeatedly — each pass producing a finer grade. Hot sake uses the unpolished leftovers. Higher-quality cold sake also produces fewer headaches the next day.

Sake has been brewed in Japan for over 2,000 years. It is made from rice, water, yeast, and koji mold. The brewing process is closer to beer than wine.

Three small cups arrive on a wooden flight board. Smell each one before tasting. Start with the lightest (junmai), move to the middle, and finish with the most aromatic.

Sake contains approximately 130 calories per 5oz serving. It is naturally free of sulfites and has lower acidity than wine.

Varies across the flight: crisp, floral, fruity, and rich

Smooth, clean, and refreshing with varying body from light to full

Three premium sakes are poured into traditional sake cups (ochoko) and arranged on a wooden flight board. Your server will explain each variety, its flavor profile, and ideal food pairings.

💡 Pro Tip: Ask your server which sake pairs best with what you're ordering. they can customize your flight around your meal.

The fundamental sake pairing. clean sake with pristine sashimi

Sake and edamame is the classic Japanese bar pairing

Clean sake complements grilled salmon beautifully

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

A sake flight gives you three different sake varieties served side by side, so you can taste and compare them. It's the perfect way to discover which style of sake you enjoy most. from light and crisp to rich and aromatic.

Our flight typically includes a range of styles. from a clean, everyday junmai to a more aromatic and refined daiginjo. The selection may vary, but each flight is curated to showcase the diversity of Japanese sake.

It depends on the style! Premium daiginjo sakes are best served chilled to preserve their delicate aromatics. More robust junmai styles can be wonderful warm. Our flight is typically served chilled, but ask your server for warm options.

Also available at our Frisco location

- Tokyo Mule
Cocktails • Jinbeh Lewisville

Japan Meets Moscow. Ginger Beer, Sake, and Fresh Lime

Our Japanese twist on the classic Moscow Mule. Instead of vodka, we use premium sake. adding a smooth, rice-wine complexity to the spicy ginger beer and bright fresh lime. Served ice-cold in a copper mug, the Tokyo Mule is crisp, refreshing, and has a spicy ginger bite that wakes up your palate. The perfect drink between courses.

Our bartender developed the Tokyo Mule as a Japanese twist on the classic Moscow Mule. Replacing vodka with premium sake creates a smoother, more nuanced cocktail. The copper mug keeps it ice-cold.

The Moscow Mule was invented in 1940s America. Jinbeh's Tokyo Mule swaps vodka for sake, adding rice-wine complexity to the ginger beer and lime foundation.

The copper mug arrives frosted and ice-cold. The ginger beer fizzes at the first sip. The sake adds smoothness that rounds out the sharp ginger and tart lime. The mug stays cold to the last drop.

The Tokyo Mule contains approximately 170 calories. Ginger beer provides natural ginger with anti-inflammatory properties. Fresh lime juice adds vitamin C.

Spicy ginger beer with smooth sake and bright lime citrus

Effervescent, ice-cold, and crisp with a ginger tingle

Premium sake is poured over ice in a copper mug, topped with spicy ginger beer and a generous squeeze of fresh lime. Garnished with a lime wheel and candied ginger.

💡 Pro Tip: Order a Tokyo Mule between your appetizer and main course. the ginger beer refreshes your palate perfectly.

The ginger bite cuts through the richness of a bold steak

Spicy ginger drink with simple, salty edamame

Ginger beer cools the spicy tuna while complementing the flavors

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

The base spirit! A Moscow Mule uses vodka, while our Tokyo Mule substitutes premium sake. The sake adds a smooth, slightly sweet, and more complex flavor that pairs better with Japanese cuisine. Both feature ginger beer and lime.

Yes! Like the classic mule, our Tokyo Mule is served in a traditional copper mug. The copper keeps the drink extra cold and adds to the experience.

Also available at our Frisco location

Hibachi • Jinbeh Lewisville

Tender Chicken Breast with Bright Lemon Sesame Glaze

Our most popular hibachi entrée and a crowd favorite for good reason. Juicy chicken breast is seared golden on the teppanyaki grill and finished with a bright lemon sesame glaze that balances sweet, tangy, and nutty flavors. A perfect introduction to hibachi dining for first-timers and a reliable favorite for regulars.

Our teriyaki sauce is entirely homemade — a sweet soy-based glaze that's become a family favorite. Fun fact: our fried rice is made with finely chopped scallion, onion, and carrots cut so small they're invisible. This is deliberate — kids (and some adults) don't want to see vegetables.

Teriyaki comes from the Japanese words "teri" (shine) and "yaki" (grill). Our lemon sesame variation adds bright citrus and nutty sesame to the classic glaze, reflecting over 35 years of creative fusion at Jinbeh.

The full hibachi show accompanies every chicken dinner. Your chef performs the onion volcano, flips shrimp into guests' mouths, and juggles spatulas while your chicken sears to golden perfection. Kids love every moment.

Boneless chicken breast is one of the leanest proteins available. A hibachi serving delivers approximately 220 calories and 30g protein. Combined with grilled vegetables and rice, it offers a balanced, satisfying meal.

Bright, tangy lemon with toasted sesame and sweet teriyaki

Juicy and tender with a golden seared exterior

Boneless chicken breast is sliced and seared on the teppanyaki grill with sesame oil. Your chef creates the signature onion volcano and performs entertaining knife tricks while the chicken cooks to a perfect golden finish, then glazes it with house-made lemon sesame sauce.

💡 Pro Tip: Ask for extra Yum Yum sauce. our house-made version is legendary and goes perfectly with the lemon sesame chicken.

Sweet lychee complements the citrus notes in the chicken

Pan-fried dumplings are the classic Japanese appetizer pairing

Mild and approachable, just like the chicken. a natural match

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

Absolutely! Lemon Sesame Chicken is one of our most kid-friendly options. The mild, familiar flavor appeals to younger diners, and the interactive hibachi cooking show keeps everyone entertained. We also offer a children's hibachi chicken at a lower price for kids 10 and under.

Yes! Our Jinbeh Double Delight lets you pick two proteins. chicken with steak or chicken with shrimp are popular combos. The Tokyo Trio combines filet mignon, chicken, and garlic lemon shrimp for the ultimate tasting experience.

Also available at our Frisco location

Hibachi • Jinbeh Lewisville

Lobster Tail, Shrimp, and Scallops. A Triple Seafood Feast

Our ultimate seafood experience. A whole lobster tail, colossal shrimp, and jumbo scallops. all seared together on the teppanyaki grill. Three distinct ocean flavors and textures in one breathtaking dinner. If you love seafood, this is your dream meal.

The Seafood Lover's Combo is Jinbeh's ultimate ocean feast. It draws guests who want lobster, shrimp, and scallops all on one plate. This combination outsells every other pure-seafood option on the menu.

Japanese cuisine has a deep tradition of celebrating the ocean's bounty. The teppanyaki format allows three distinct seafood textures and flavors to cook simultaneously.

Three seafood proteins on the grill at once creates a spectacular visual. Your chef manages scallop searing, shrimp flipping, and lobster basting simultaneously. The precision makes this one of the most impressive cooking performances.

Lobster, shrimp, and scallops together deliver roughly 380 calories and 55g protein. This is the highest-protein, lowest-fat entrée combination on the Jinbeh hibachi menu.

A symphony of ocean flavors. sweet lobster, briny shrimp, buttery scallops

Three distinct textures from tender to springy to silky

Your chef arranges all three seafood proteins on the teppanyaki grill, timing each one precisely so the scallops sear perfectly, the shrimp curl just right, and the lobster is butter-basted to tenderness. all finishing at the same time.

💡 Pro Tip: Start with the scallops (most delicate), then the shrimp, then save the rich lobster for last. it's the perfect order for building flavors.

Sample multiple sakes to pair with each type of seafood

Keep it light before the main event

Add a dramatic sushi presentation to your seafood feast

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

You get three premium seafood proteins: a whole Maine lobster tail, colossal butterflied shrimp, and jumbo seared scallops. All three are prepared together on the teppanyaki grill by your personal chef.

Yes! The Seafood Lover's Combo is our most generous pure-seafood offering. For even more variety, the Imperial Dinner for Two adds filet mignon and a California roll to the seafood mix.

Hibachi • Jinbeh Lewisville

Pick Two Proteins: Steak, Chicken, or Shrimp

Can't decide between two favorites? The Jinbeh Double Delight lets you choose any two proteins. steak and chicken, chicken and shrimp, or steak and shrimp. It's the best way to sample multiple flavors in one sitting, all prepared tableside by our expert teppanyaki chefs.

The Jinbeh Double Delight is our best-selling combination dinner. This option exists because guests kept asking to try two proteins in one sitting without committing to the larger combos.

Combination dinners became popular in American teppanyaki restaurants during the 1970s. They allow guests to sample multiple preparations in a single meal, turning dinner into a tasting experience.

Your chef prepares both proteins side by side on the grill, each with its own seasoning and timing. Watching the contrast between searing steak and grilling chicken highlights the chef's range and precision.

Combining two proteins gives you variety without doubling the portion. A steak-and-chicken combo delivers roughly 400 calories and 45g protein, making it a balanced option.

Varies by your choice. the best of two worlds

A satisfying variety of textures in one meal

Your chef prepares both proteins side-by-side on the teppanyaki grill. Each is seasoned and cooked to its ideal temperature, so you get the best possible version of both choices in one meal.

💡 Pro Tip: The steak-and-shrimp combo is the crowd favorite, but chicken-and-shrimp is a lighter option that's equally delicious.

Celebratory and fun. just like ordering a combo

Dumplings are the perfect appetizer before a multi-protein feast

Add a roll to make it a true Japanese tasting experience

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

You can pick any two from: sirloin steak, chicken breast, or colossal shrimp. All combinations are prepared together on the teppanyaki grill so you can enjoy the perfect variety in one meal.

Steak and shrimp is our most popular Double Delight combination, followed closely by chicken and steak. But all combinations are delicious. it really comes down to your personal preference.

Also available at our Frisco location

Hibachi • Jinbeh Lewisville

- Hibachi N.Y. Strip Steak
Hibachi • Jinbeh Lewisville

Bold, Beefy Flavor with a Perfect Charred Crust

A steakhouse classic prepared with Japanese flair. Our N.Y. strip offers a more robust, beefy flavor than the filet mignon, with a satisfying strip of fat along the edge that bastes the meat as it cooks. Cut thick and seared hot on the teppanyaki grill for maximum flavor.

When a customer orders steak at the hibachi, our chefs receive the temperature preference directly — using a numbered doneness system from 1 through 8. The grills reach 550°F, ensuring a perfect sear every time.

The New York strip gets its name from Delmonico's restaurant in Manhattan, which popularized the cut in the 1800s. On a Japanese teppanyaki grill, the fat cap renders far more effectively than a standard broiler.

Your chef sears the strip on the hottest part of the grill, rendering the fat cap until it sizzles. The steak is sliced tableside and arranged on your plate with precision. Expect the onion volcano, egg tricks, and flying utensils throughout.

N.Y. strip provides roughly 280 calories and 28g protein per 6oz serving. The fat cap along the edge carries flavor without dramatically increasing the calorie count.

Bold, beefy, and richly savory with a smoky char

Firm yet tender with excellent chew and a fatty, flavorful edge

The N.Y. strip is seared on the blazing-hot teppanyaki grill. The fat cap renders and bastes the steak as it cooks. Your chef will slice it for easy sharing and drizzle with soy butter glaze.

The ginger bite cuts through the richness of the steak

The N.Y. Strip has a bolder, beefier flavor with a satisfying strip of fat that adds richness. Filet Mignon is more tender and buttery with a milder flavor. Both are prepared tableside on our teppanyaki grill. it comes down to whether you prefer bold beef flavor (strip) or melt-in-your-mouth tenderness (filet).

We recommend medium-rare to medium. The N.Y. strip has excellent marbling that needs heat to render, so medium-rare brings out the best flavor and texture while keeping the center juicy and pink.

Hibachi • Jinbeh Lewisville

Fresh Atlantic Salmon with Citrus Teriyaki Glaze

Our teppanyaki chefs sear premium Atlantic salmon on a 400°F grill, finishing it with a bright citrus teriyaki glaze that caramelizes beautifully. The salmon is cooked to a perfect medium with a golden crust and tender, flaky interior. Rich in omega-3 fatty acids and high-quality protein, this is one of the healthiest and most flavorful choices on our hibachi menu.

Our hibachi salmon is cooked on grills reaching 550°F to achieve the perfect sear. Every sauce on your plate is made from scratch in our kitchen — from the Yum Yum sauce to the garlic butter. Recipes are posted on the kitchen walls so every chef learns them.

Teppanyaki-style salmon cooking originated in post-war Japan when restaurants began grilling Western-style proteins on iron hot plates. The citrus teriyaki preparation blends traditional Japanese flavors with modern presentation.

Your chef sears the salmon right at your table on a 400°F teppanyaki grill. Watch the citrus teriyaki glaze bubble and caramelize as the onion volcano erupts nearby. The aroma alone is worth the visit.

Atlantic salmon delivers 25-28g of protein per 5oz serving with only 200-250 calories. It is one of nature's richest sources of heart-healthy omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA), supporting cardiovascular health and brain function.

Sweet, citrusy, and rich with caramelized teriyaki notes

Tender and flaky with a golden seared crust

Your chef sears the salmon fillet skin-side down on the teppanyaki grill, then flips and bastes it with our house-made citrus teriyaki glaze. The high heat creates a beautiful caramelized exterior while keeping the inside perfectly moist and tender.

💡 Pro Tip: Ask your chef for extra citrus teriyaki glaze on the side. it's incredible drizzled over the rice too!

Clean sake complements the rich salmon beautifully

Light and refreshing starter before a rich entrée

Add sushi to your hibachi for the ultimate Japanese feast

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

Our skilled teppanyaki chefs sear your salmon fillet on a 400°F iron grill right at your table. The salmon is finished with a citrus teriyaki glaze and served alongside the full hibachi experience. complete with the famous onion volcano, flying shrimp appetizer, and entertaining knife work.

Your hibachi salmon dinner includes Japanese onion soup, house salad with our signature ginger dressing, a shrimp appetizer, hibachi vegetables (zucchini, onions, mushrooms), steamed rice (fried rice upgrade available), and your choice of dipping sauces including our famous Yum Yum sauce.

Absolutely! Atlantic salmon is one of the healthiest proteins available. rich in heart-healthy omega-3 fatty acids, high-quality protein, and essential vitamins. It's an excellent choice for health-conscious diners who still want a memorable dining experience.

Yes! Our Jinbeh Double Delight lets you pick two proteins, and our Land and Sea combo pairs sirloin with your choice of seafood. Ask your server about customizing your hibachi combination.

Hibachi • Jinbeh Lewisville

Sweet, Caramelized Jumbo Sea Scallops Seared Tableside

Plump jumbo sea scallops, seared to a golden caramel crust on our teppanyaki grill. These ocean gems have a natural sweetness that intensifies when the high heat of the grill creates a perfect Maillard reaction. Each scallop is a bite-sized masterpiece. crispy gold outside, impossibly silky inside.

Jumbo scallops are a signature choice at Jinbeh for guests who appreciate delicate seafood. Our chefs sear them at peak temperature to achieve a flawless golden crust. Many regulars pair them with a sake flight for a refined Japanese dining experience.

Sea scallops are harvested from the cold waters of the Atlantic. In Japanese cuisine, scallops (hotategai) are prized for their natural sweetness. The teppanyaki grill creates a caramelized sear impossible to replicate in a standard kitchen.

Watch your chef pat each scallop dry before placing it on the scorching grill. The initial sizzle is dramatic. Within minutes, a golden crust forms while the interior stays silky.

Scallops provide roughly 140 calories and 20g protein per serving. They are exceptionally low in fat and high in magnesium, potassium, and B12.

Sweet, delicate ocean flavor with caramelized butter notes

Silky and creamy inside with a golden seared crust

Jumbo sea scallops are patted dry and placed on the scorching-hot teppanyaki grill to develop a deep golden crust. Your chef sears each side for 2-3 minutes, creating a beautiful caramelization that locks in the natural sweetness.

💡 Pro Tip: Scallops pair beautifully with butter sauce. ask for our garlic butter on the side for dipping.

Clean, crisp sake lets the delicate scallop flavor shine

Start with seared fish, finish with seared scallops. a seafood journey

Spicy yellowtail provides an exciting contrast to sweet scallops

Scallops have a sweet, delicate ocean flavor. somewhat similar to lobster but lighter and more refined. When seared on our teppanyaki grill, they develop a rich, caramelized crust that adds buttery depth. They're a must-try for seafood lovers and a gentle introduction for curious diners.

Our chefs sear jumbo sea scallops on the teppanyaki grill at very high heat. The key is a perfect sear. golden and caramelized on the outside, silky and barely set on the inside. The result is one of the most elegant bites in Japanese cuisine.

Hibachi • Jinbeh Lewisville

Fresh Seasonal Vegetables and Tofu Grilled to Perfection

Proof that hibachi isn't just about meat. Our vegetarian hibachi features a generous assortment of fresh seasonal vegetables and firm tofu, grilled on the teppanyaki surface with garlic butter and soy sauce. You still get the full onion volcano show, the entertaining knife work, and every bit of the hibachi experience. just plant-powered.

Jinbeh's hibachi is naturally friendly to plant-based diets. Gluten-free is easy — only the sauces contain gluten, not the base ingredients. Fried rice can be made gluten-free on request. Our chefs handle allergy situations carefully at 550°F grill temperatures.

Tofu (doufu) has been a protein staple in Japanese cuisine for over 1,000 years. Buddhist monks popularized tofu dishes in Japan, and teppanyaki grilling adds a modern, interactive twist to this ancient ingredient.

You get the complete show. Same onion volcano. Same flying egg trick. Same impressive knife work. The only difference is the protein on the grill.

Firm tofu delivers 10g protein per half-cup serving with only 90 calories. Combined with grilled zucchini, onions, mushrooms, and broccoli, this dinner provides a full spectrum of vitamins and plant-based nutrients.

Sashimi • Jinbeh Lewisville

A Beautiful Bowl of Assorted Sashimi Over Seasoned Sushi Rice

Chirashi means "scattered". and this traditional Japanese bowl features an artful arrangement of assorted sashimi pieces scattered over a bed of warm seasoned sushi rice. It's the perfect bridge between sashimi and sushi, giving you the purity of raw fish with the satisfying substance of seasoned rice. Each bowl is a miniature edible art piece.

Chirashi is the choice for sashimi lovers who want a complete meal. The warm seasoned rice under the cold fish creates a comforting contrast. Jinbeh's chirashi bowl is generous.

Chirashi-zushi ("scattered sushi") is a traditional Japanese home-cooking dish often served during the Hinamatsuri (Girls' Day) festival.

The bowl arrives with jewel-colored fish covering warm seasoned rice. Tuna, salmon, yellowtail, and shrimp glisten against the white rice. Mix wasabi into soy sauce and drizzle over the top.

A chirashi bowl delivers approximately 450 calories and 35g protein. The warm sushi rice adds complex carbohydrates, while the sashimi provides lean protein and omega-3s.

Multiple fish flavors harmonized by warm, seasoned sushi rice

Silky sashimi over warm, slightly sticky rice

A generous bowl of warm seasoned sushi rice is topped with an assortment of fresh sashimi slices. typically including tuna, salmon, yellowtail, shrimp, and seasonal selections. Garnished with pickled ginger, wasabi, and nori strips.

💡 Pro Tip: Mix a small amount of wasabi into your soy sauce and drizzle it lightly over the entire bowl. the flavors meld with the warm rice beautifully.

The ginger in the mule echoes the pickled ginger in the chirashi

Hot dumplings before a fresh, cool chirashi bowl

Add a cooked eel roll to balance the raw chirashi

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

Chirashi (Japanese for "scattered") is a traditional Japanese dish featuring assorted sashimi slices artfully arranged over a bowl of warm seasoned sushi rice. It's the casual, bowl-style version of a sushi/sashimi platter. satisfying, beautiful, and a great way to sample multiple fish.

Sashimi is pure sliced fish with no rice. Chirashi serves sliced fish over a base of warm seasoned sushi rice, making it more of a complete meal. Think of chirashi as the sashimi lover's way to have a filling dish.

Also available at our Frisco location

Sashimi • Jinbeh Lewisville

Tender Sliced Octopus with a Unique, Satisfying Chew

For the adventurous diner, our octopus sashimi (tako) offers a completely unique sashimi experience. The octopus is gently poached until tender, then sliced thin to showcase its beautiful purple-and-white color pattern. The flavor is mild, clean, and subtly sweet, with a satisfying chew that's unlike any other sashimi.

Octopus sashimi is Jinbeh's choice for adventurous diners. The kitchen gently poaches the octopus until tender, then chills it before slicing. The purple and white pattern creates a beautiful presentation.

Octopus (tako) has been part of Japanese cuisine for thousands of years. It plays a significant role in cultural festivals and is considered a symbol of good fortune.

The sliced tentacle reveals a beautiful purple exterior and white interior. Each piece has a pleasant bounce when you bite into it. The mild, clean flavor surprises first-timers.

Octopus is remarkably lean: 140 calories and 25g protein per 4oz serving. It is rich in iron, vitamin B12, and taurine.

Mild, clean, and subtly sweet with a fresh ocean finish

Tender with a pleasant, bouncy chew. uniquely satisfying

Each omakase experience is unique, featuring the chef's most inspired creations and the best seasonal fish available. This is the pinnacle of Japanese dining.

Omakase at Jinbeh is a direct conversation between guest and chef. Our sushi master selects the finest fish of the day and prepares courses that build from delicate to rich.

Omakase means "I leave it to you" in Japanese. It represents the highest level of trust between diner and chef. The tradition dates back to Edo-period Tokyo sushi stalls.

Sit at the sushi bar for the full experience. The chef presents each course individually, explaining the fish and why it made the cut. Each piece is prepared moments before it reaches you.

Omakase (oh-mah-KAH-seh) is Japanese for "I'll leave it to you." When you order omakase, you trust the sushi chef to create a personalized tasting experience using the day's freshest and finest ingredients. It's the highest expression of trust between a diner and chef in Japanese cuisine.

The beauty of omakase is letting the chef surprise you. However, you should let your server know about any allergies or strong dislikes before the experience begins. The chef will tailor the experience to your preferences while still introducing you to new flavors and preparations.

Pristine Slices of Fresh Atlantic Salmon, No Rice Required

Pure, unadulterated salmon in its most elegant form. Sashimi strips away everything except the fish itself. no rice, no seaweed. Just the finest salmon, sliced by master hands.

In Japanese, 'sashimi' means 'sliced' — just the raw fish, no rice. Our head sushi chef selects the freshest cuts daily. Try our Sashimi Sampler for the three most popular fish at a discount.

Sashimi has been part of Japanese cuisine since the Kamakura period (1185-1333). The word means "pierced body," referencing the practice of placing the fish tail near the slices to identify the species.

Each slice glistens on the plate, showing the fish's natural marbling. Place a tiny dab of wasabi directly on the fish for the cleanest hit of heat. Let each slice rest on your tongue momentarily.

Sushi Rolls • Jinbeh Lewisville

Stacked Layers of Fresh Ahi Tuna, Avocado & Crispy Rice

Our most dramatic sushi presentation. Layers of fresh sushi-grade ahi tuna, ripe avocado, and crispy seasoned rice are stacked tower-style and artfully presented. Each bite delivers a symphony of flavors and textures. silky raw tuna, creamy avocado, and crunchy rice. This is a show-stopping appetizer or sushi course that always turns heads.

The Ahi Tower is Jinbeh's most Instagram-worthy dish. Groups order it as a dramatic table centerpiece. Every tower is built with a ring mold and carefully unmolded for maximum visual impact.

Tuna tartare towers gained popularity in high-end Japanese fusion restaurants during the 1990s. The stacked presentation emphasizes the quality of the fish.

The tower arrives standing tall: crispy rice on the bottom, vibrant green avocado in the middle, and ruby-red tuna on top. Your server presents it with a flourish before you break into the layers.

Ahi tuna is exceptionally lean, delivering 25g protein with only 120 calories per 4oz serving. The avocado adds potassium and fiber.

Clean, ocean-fresh tuna with creamy avocado and savory sesame

Silky raw tuna over creamy avocado and satisfyingly crunchy rice

Layers of fresh ahi tuna, seasoned avocado, and crispy rice are carefully stacked using a ring mold. The tower is unmolded tableside, garnished with sesame seeds, scallions, and a drizzle of ponzu.

💡 Pro Tip: Order the Ahi Tower as a dramatic first course for the table. it's the most Instagram-worthy dish on our menu.

Clean sake enhances the fresh tuna flavor

Double down on ahi tuna with two different preparations

Follow a stunning sushi presentation with a luxurious hibachi course

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

An Ahi Tower is a stacked sushi presentation. layers of fresh ahi tuna, avocado, and crispy rice are carefully assembled in a tower shape and presented as a dramatic, architectural dish. It's one of our most photogenic and delicious creations.

Absolutely! The Ahi Tower is actually one of our best sharing options. it's designed to be an impressive centerpiece. Groups love ordering one to share while deciding on their main courses.

- Home

- California Roll
Sushi Rolls • Jinbeh Lewisville

The Classic Gateway Roll with Crab, Avocado & Cucumber

The California Roll is the most popular sushi roll in America. and our version is crafted with real crab meat, perfectly ripe avocado, and crisp cucumber, wrapped in seasoned sushi rice and toasted sesame seeds. An inside-out roll that's mild, creamy, and endlessly satisfying. The perfect introduction to sushi and a staple for every visit.

Every roll at Jinbeh is crafted using a traditional bamboo roller (makisu) by our sushi team, led by a master chef who has been with us for nearly 30 years. He co-created every signature roll on our menu during late-night sessions of testing and perfecting.

The California Roll was invented in the 1960s by a Japanese chef in Los Angeles who substituted crab for toro. The inside-out style hid the nori seaweed, making it more approachable for American diners.

Watch our sushi chef roll this classic behind the sushi bar with practiced speed. The rice is spread, crab and avocado are placed, and in seconds the roll is shaped, sliced into eight clean pieces, and presented.

A California Roll provides approximately 250 calories and 9g protein per roll. It is low in saturated fat and a good source of healthy monounsaturated fats from the avocado.

Mild, creamy, and subtly sweet with buttery avocado

Sushi Rolls • Jinbeh Lewisville

Eel and Cucumber Topped with Avocado and Sweet Eel Sauce

A showstopper that looks as dramatic as it tastes. The Dragon Roll features smoky, sweet broiled eel (unagi) and crisp cucumber inside, draped with thin slices of ripe avocado arranged to resemble dragon scales. Finished with a generous drizzle of our house-made sweet eel sauce. This is one of the most visually stunning and flavorful rolls on our menu.

Hand-rolled using a traditional bamboo makisu by our sushi team. The dragon roll showcases our sushi master's 30 years of artistry — each piece precisely cut to reveal the beautiful layers inside.

Eel (unagi) is a prized delicacy in Japan, traditionally prepared kabayaki style: filleted, steamed, then broiled with a sweet soy glaze. The Dragon Roll transforms this classic preparation into a show-stopping sushi presentation.

The chef arranges thin avocado slices to resemble dragon scales across the top. Sweet eel sauce is drizzled in artistic lines. When presented, the roll genuinely resembles a green serpent curling across your plate.

Unagi eel provides roughly 200 calories and 20g protein per serving. It is one of the few natural food sources of vitamin A and vitamin E.

Sweet, smoky eel with rich unagi sauce and buttery avocado

Tender eel, creamy avocado, and crisp cucumber in every bite

Broiled freshwater eel (unagi) and cucumber are rolled inside seasoned sushi rice. The roll is then carefully draped with thinly sliced avocado fanned to resemble dragon scales, and finished with sweet eel sauce (tare) and sesame seeds.

💡 Pro Tip: The Dragon Roll pairs exceptionally well with hot sake. the warm sake enhances the sweet, smoky eel flavors beautifully.

The sweetness of the eel sauce pairs perfectly with crisp sake

Crispy crab followed by rich eel. a seafood lover's dream

Start with the dramatic Dragon Roll, then enjoy a dramatic hibachi show

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

Unagi is broiled freshwater eel. a Japanese delicacy with a sweet, smoky, and rich flavor. It's always served fully cooked, broiled with a thick, caramelized sweet sauce. The texture is tender and succulent, almost like a very soft fish. If you enjoy sweet, savory flavors, you'll love unagi.

Yes! All eel (unagi) at Jinbeh is fully cooked. broiled and basted in sweet soy-based tare sauce. It's a great option for diners who prefer cooked sushi.

The avocado slices are fanned across the top to resemble dragon scales, and when presented on the plate, the roll looks like a green dragon. Combined with the eel sauce drizzle, it's one of the most visually striking rolls we make.

Sushi Rolls • Jinbeh Lewisville

Silky Salmon with Rich Cream Cheese and Fresh Cucumber

An American-born classic. The Philadelphia Roll combines silky fresh salmon with smooth cream cheese and crisp cucumber for a rich, indulgent take on sushi. The cream cheese adds a luxurious creaminess that melts into the cold salmon, creating a flavor combination that's become one of the most popular rolls in the country.

The Philadelphia Roll is a consistent top seller for guests who enjoy rich, creamy flavors. Our sushi chefs use quality cream cheese and fresh salmon. Loyal regulars order this alongside their hibachi dinner.

The Philadelphia Roll was born in the 1980s, named after the famous cream cheese brand. It represents the creative fusion of Japanese technique and American ingredients.

Cold salmon, smooth cream cheese, and crisp cucumber create three distinct textures in a single bite. The temperature stays cool throughout, making this a refreshing choice between warm hibachi courses.

The cream cheese adds richness plus calcium and vitamin A. A complete Philly Roll runs approximately 320 calories and 14g protein.

Silky salmon melting into smooth cream cheese with cucumber crunch

Fresh salmon and cream cheese are rolled with cucumber in seasoned sushi rice and nori. The combination of cold, rich ingredients creates a uniquely smooth and satisfying roll.

💡 Pro Tip: Ask for your Philly Roll with a drizzle of eel sauce on top. the sweet glaze adds an amazing depth to the cream cheese and salmon.

The ginger cuts through the richness of the cream cheese

Light and refreshing before a rich roll

Bright citrus chicken complements the rich cream cheese roll

This colorful creation highlights the range of fresh fish we source daily. Our sushi master selects the finest cuts of salmon, tuna, and yellowtail to drape over each roll — a testament to nearly three decades of supplier relationships.

The Rainbow Roll is an American sushi innovation that showcases the range of a sushi bar. By draping different sashimi over a California Roll base, it becomes a visual menu of available fish.

The chef carefully drapes alternating slices of tuna, salmon, yellowtail, shrimp, and avocado. Deep red, bright orange, pale pink, pink-white, and green. It arrives looking like an edible rainbow.

The variety of fish delivers a broad spectrum of nutrients: omega-3s from salmon, lean protein from tuna, and healthy fats from yellowtail. Total calories run 350-400 per roll.

Sushi Rolls • Jinbeh Lewisville

Crispy Fried Shrimp Tempura Rolled with Avocado & Cucumber

Crispy meets fresh in this beloved roll. Whole shrimp are lightly battered and fried tempura-style until golden and crunchy, then rolled with ripe avocado and cucumber in seasoned sushi rice. The contrast between the crispy hot tempura and the cool, creamy avocado is what makes this roll unforgettable.

Combines our crispy tempura technique with the precision of hand-rolled maki. At Jinbeh, tempura uses a thick batter for maximum crunch — distinct from the lighter 'agedashi' style.

Tempura was introduced to Japan by Portuguese missionaries in the 16th century. The Japanese refined the batter to become whisper-thin. Rolling tempura inside sushi is a modern Japanese-American creation.

The crunch when you bite through the roll is the star moment. The tempura batter shatters, the cool rice gives way, and the creamy avocado smooths everything together.

Despite being fried, the light tempura batter keeps the roll around 300 calories. Shrimp provides lean protein (22g per roll), and avocado adds heart-healthy fats.

Crispy, savory shrimp with cool creamy avocado

Crunchy tempura exterior with soft rice and creamy avocado

Whole shrimp are lightly battered in our tempura flour blend and fried until perfectly golden. They're immediately rolled with avocado and cucumber in seasoned sushi rice and nori while still warm and crispy.

💡 Pro Tip: Ask for spicy mayo on the side for dipping. the creamy heat takes the shrimp tempura roll to another level.

Tropical fruity punch pairs perfectly with crispy shrimp

Double down on tempura. appetizer and roll

Pair crispy sushi with grilled hibachi for variety

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

Yes! The shrimp is fully cooked. battered and fried tempura-style. Combined with avocado and cucumber, it's a great cooked sushi option for anyone who prefers their seafood fully cooked.

We fry the shrimp immediately before rolling to keep maximum crispiness. The light tempura batter stays crunchy even inside the roll. For extra crunch, ask for tempura flakes on top.

Sushi Rolls • Jinbeh Lewisville

Fresh Tuna with Fiery Sriracha Mayo and Scallion Crunch

Our Spicy Tuna Roll delivers a perfect balance of heat and ocean-fresh flavor. Diced sushi-grade ahi tuna is tossed in our house-blended spicy mayo, layered with fresh scallions, and rolled in seasoned rice and nori. A little kick, a lot of freshness, and a satisfying crunch from the tobiko topping.

Our spicy tuna roll features our house-made Blaster sauce — Jinbeh's spicy option that even non-spicy customers handle fine. For the truly bold, we keep a secret sriracha-togarashi paste that brings real heat.

The Spicy Tuna Roll emerged in the 1980s from Japanese-American sushi bars. Mixing raw tuna with spicy mayo was a creative way to use trim cuts of high-quality fish.

Fresh tuna is diced to order at the sushi bar. The bright red fish mixes with the creamy spicy mayo right before your eyes. The roll is finished with orange tobiko that pops with each bite.

Ahi tuna is packed with lean protein (about 25g per roll) and omega-3 fatty acids. The spicy mayo adds some calories, but the overall roll stays around 290 calories.

Fresh tuna with creamy spicy mayo heat and savory depth

Silky raw tuna with rice and a tobiko pop

Sushi-grade ahi tuna is hand-diced and mixed with our house spicy mayo blend. Rolled with scallions in seasoned sushi rice and nori, topped with tobiko (flying fish roe) for color and crunch.

💡 Pro Tip: Ask for your Spicy Tuna Roll to be made "extra crunchy" with tempura flakes on top. the texture contrast is incredible.

Ginger beer cools the spice while complementing the tuna

Savory dumplings balance the spicy roll nicely

A mild hibachi entrée complements a spicy roll

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

It has a moderate kick from our house-blended spicy mayo. flavorful without being overwhelming. If you enjoy mild heat, you'll love it. Ask for extra spicy if you want more fire, or less spicy for a gentler version.

Yes, we use fresh sushi-grade ahi tuna. It's hand-diced and mixed with spicy mayo for a melt-in-your-mouth texture. All our sushi-grade fish is sourced for the highest quality and freshness.

Also available at our Frisco location

Sushi Rolls • Jinbeh Lewisville

Whole Crispy Soft Shell Crab with Avocado & Spicy Mayo

Named for the way the crispy crab legs peek out from each end like spider legs, our Spider Roll is built around a whole soft shell crab, lightly fried and stuffed inside with avocado, cucumber, and lettuce. The entire crab. shell and all. is edible and delicious, offering a unique crunch that no other roll can match.

Features our deep-fried soft shell crab inside a hand-rolled maki. Our sushi master — nearly 30 years with Jinbeh — selects every piece of seafood with the precision you'd expect from decades of daily practice.

Soft shell crabs are blue crabs harvested right after molting, when the new shell is paper-thin and fully edible. Japanese chefs adopted soft shell crab for sushi in the 1970s.

The fried crab legs extend from each end of every sushi piece, creating a dramatic spidery appearance. Biting into the roll releases a satisfying crunch followed by sweet, delicate crab meat.

Soft shell crab provides approximately 18g protein per crab with calcium from the edible shell. The light frying adds around 320 total calories per roll.

Crispy, sweet crab with creamy avocado and tangy spicy mayo

Exceptionally crunchy with a creamy, cool center

A whole soft shell crab is lightly dusted and fried until golden and crispy. It's placed in the center of the roll with avocado, cucumber, and lettuce, then rolled and finished with spicy mayo and eel sauce.

💡 Pro Tip: If you love the Spider Roll, try our Soft Shell Crab appetizer first. it's the same incredible crab served on its own.

Sweet lychee complements the sweet crab beautifully

Seared fish followed by crispy crab. a textural journey

Two shellfish experiences. crispy crab then seared scallops

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

Yes! Soft shell crab is harvested right after molting when the new shell is paper-thin and completely edible. When fried, it becomes deliciously crispy. you eat the entire crab, legs and all. It's one of the most unique textures in sushi.

When the soft shell crab is placed inside the roll, its fried legs stick out from each end, resembling spider legs. It's a dramatic presentation that looks as impressive as it tastes.

Also available at our Frisco location

Shrimp Tempura Topped with Fresh Avocado and Spicy Stripes

Bold and beautiful. The Tiger Roll wraps crispy shrimp tempura inside with avocado and cucumber, then crowns the outside with fresh avocado slices and dramatic stripes of spicy mayo and eel sauce. creating the tiger-stripe pattern that gives this roll its name. A satisfying combination of crunch, creaminess, and a touch of heat.

The Tiger Roll combines the crispy appeal of shrimp tempura with an artistic stripe pattern on top. Guests who enjoy bold visual presentation alongside great flavor choose this roll regularly.

The Tiger Roll is named for the distinctive striped pattern of alternating spicy mayo and eel sauce across the avocado topping.

Tiger stripes of alternating red spicy mayo and brown eel sauce across green avocado create a striking look. The first crunch of shrimp tempura gives way to cool, creamy avocado.

The combination of shrimp tempura and avocado delivers approximately 310 calories and 18g protein.

Crunchy tempura shrimp with smooth avocado and rice

Sushi Rolls • Jinbeh Lewisville

Deep-Fried Sushi Roll with Cream Cheese and Spicy Crab

Inspired by the indulgence of Las Vegas. Our Vegas Roll is a unique deep-fried sushi experience. the entire roll is lightly battered and fried until golden and crispy, then served with spicy mayo and eel sauce. Inside, you'll find cream cheese and spicy crab filling. It's decadent, crunchy, and completely irresistible.

The Vegas Roll is Jinbeh's most indulgent sushi creation. Guests who love crispy, fried textures and rich cream cheese gravitate to this roll. It sells especially well on weekend nights.

Deep-fried sushi rolls are a distinctly American innovation inspired by the indulgence of Las Vegas cuisine. The entire roll is battered and fried.

The entire roll arrives golden and crispy, still steaming from the fryer. Cutting into it reveals a warm, melted cream cheese center. The contrast between crispy shell and soft interior is unforgettable.

As a deep-fried roll, the Vegas Roll is the most indulgent sushi option at approximately 380 calories. The cream cheese adds calcium.

Rich, crispy, and indulgent with sweet and spicy notes

Shatteringly crispy exterior with a warm, creamy center

The roll is assembled with cream cheese and spicy crab, then the entire roll is lightly battered and deep-fried until golden and crispy. Served immediately with spicy mayo and eel sauce drizzle.

💡 Pro Tip: Eat the Vegas Roll immediately. the crispy exterior is at its absolute best in the first few minutes after frying.

A fun, indulgent drink for a fun, indulgent roll

Fried dumplings and fried sushi. a crispy feast

Sushi Rolls • Jinbeh Lewisville

Baked Spicy Crab and Scallop Topping Over a California Roll

Named for its erupting appearance, the Volcano Roll starts with a California Roll base and is crowned with a baked spicy crab and scallop mixture that bubbles and melts in the oven. The warm, creamy, slightly spicy topping over cool sushi rice creates an irresistible temperature and flavor contrast that makes this one of our most addictive rolls.

Every roll at Jinbeh is hand-crafted using a bamboo makisu by our sushi team. Our head sushi chef, who hails from southern Japan, has been with us nearly 30 years and co-created every signature roll on our menu.

Baked sushi rolls became popular in American Japanese restaurants as a way to offer warm, cooked options alongside traditional raw sushi. The erupting topping inspired the volcanic name.

The roll arrives with a golden, bubbly crown still warm from the oven. Steam rises from the baked topping. The first hot bite over cool rice is a satisfying surprise.

The baked crab and scallop topping adds protein and minerals while keeping the roll around 350 calories total.

Warm, creamy, and slightly spicy with sweet crab

Warm and bubbly baked topping over cool, smooth sushi rice

A California Roll is topped with a mixture of crab, scallop, spicy mayo, and masago. The roll is briefly baked until the topping is bubbly and golden, then drizzled with eel sauce and served immediately.

💡 Pro Tip: Eat the Volcano Roll quickly while the topping is still warm and bubbly. the temperature contrast is the magic.

Sweet tropical punch cools the mild spice

Cool edamame before a warm baked roll

Two different hot seafood preparations in one meal

Reserve your table at Jinbeh Lewisville and experience this dish prepared fresh for you.

Yes! The baked crab and scallop topping is served warm and bubbly, right out of the oven. The contrast between the warm topping and the cool sushi rice is what makes this roll so special and addictive.

Absolutely! Since everything is cooked and the flavors are mild and approachable (warm crab, creamy mayo, sweet eel sauce), it's a fantastic choice for sushi newcomers who might be hesitant about raw fish.

Fresh Yellowtail with Thin Jalapeño Slices and Cilantro Ponzu

The roll that started a sushi revolution. Inspired by Nobu's famous dish, our Yellowtail Jalapeño Roll features buttery fresh yellowtail (hamachi) paired with thin slices of fresh jalapeño that provide a clean, bright heat. Finished with cilantro, ponzu, and a hint of sesame oil. It's elegant, modern, and addictively flavorful.

This roll reflects Jinbeh's willingness to innovate within traditional Japanese cuisine. The combination of buttery hamachi with fresh jalapeño heat has earned a devoted following.

Yellowtail with jalapeño was popularized by chef Nobu Matsuhisa in the 1980s. Jinbeh's version wraps this iconic pairing inside a sushi roll with cilantro and ponzu.

The jalapeño slices are cut paper-thin. The heat arrives clean and bright without overpowering the delicate yellowtail. Each bite delivers a sequence: cool fish, sharp pepper, citrus ponzu.

Yellowtail (hamachi) is rich in omega-3 fatty acids and provides 25g protein per serving. Jalapeños contain capsaicin, which studies associate with metabolic benefits. About 280 calories per roll.

Silky raw fish with a sharp jalapeño crunch

Fresh yellowtail is sliced and paired with paper-thin jalapeño slices. Rolled in seasoned rice and finished with cilantro, a drizzle of ponzu, and a few drops of sesame oil.

Yellowtail (hamachi) is one of the most popular sushi fish. it has a buttery, mild flavor that's richer than white fish but lighter than tuna. It's incredibly smooth and delicate, making it the perfect canvas for the bright jalapeño and citrus ponzu.

Last updated: January 2026

When you visit Jinbeh Japanese Restaurant or use our services, we may collect information you provide directly, such as your name, phone number, and email address when making reservations. We also collect information automatically through cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website.

We use the information we collect to:

- Process and manage your reservations
- Send confirmation emails and reminders
- Respond to your inquiries and requests
- Improve our services and customer experience
- Send promotional communications (with your consent)
We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share information with service providers who assist us in operating our website and conducting our business, subject to confidentiality agreements.

Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, though this may affect certain website functionality.

We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information below.

Jinbeh Japanese Restaurant 2693 Preston Rd Suite 1040 Frisco, TX 75034 Phone: (214) 619-1200

Last updated: January 2026

By accessing and using the Jinbeh Japanese Restaurant website, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our website.

Reservations made through our website or third-party platforms are subject to availability. We recommend arriving on time for your reservation. Parties arriving more than 15 minutes late may have their reservation released.

For large parties or special events, please contact the restaurant directly to discuss arrangements and any deposits that may be required.

Menu items and prices are subject to change without notice. While we strive to keep our website updated, the menu and prices displayed in our restaurant shall prevail in case of any discrepancy.

Our menu items may contain allergens including but not limited to shellfish, fish, soy, gluten, eggs, and sesame. Please inform your server of any allergies before ordering. While we take precautions, we cannot guarantee that our food is completely free from allergens due to cross-contamination in our kitchen.

All content on this website, including text, graphics, logos, images, and software, is the property of Jinbeh Japanese Restaurant and is protected by copyright laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our express written permission.

When using our website, you agree not to:

- Use the site for any unlawful purpose
- Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any portion of the website
- Interfere with the proper functioning of the website
- Submit false or misleading information
Jinbeh Japanese Restaurant shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from your use of our website or services. We do not warrant that the website will be error-free or uninterrupted.

These Terms of Service shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Texas, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

For questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at:
